1→package peerdas

     3→import (

    10→	"github.com/pkg/errors"
    11→)
    12→
    13→const kzgPosition = 11 // The index of the KZG commitment list in the Body
    14→
    15→var (
    16→	ErrIndexTooLarge               = errors.New("column index is larger than the specified columns count")
    17→	ErrNoKzgCommitments            = errors.New("no KZG commitments found")
    18→	ErrMismatchLength              = errors.New("mismatch in the length of the column, commitments or proofs")
    19→	ErrInvalidKZGProof             = errors.New("invalid KZG proof")
    20→	ErrBadRootLength               = errors.New("bad root length")
    21→	ErrInvalidInclusionProof       = errors.New("invalid inclusion proof")
    22→	ErrRecordNil                   = errors.New("record is nil")
    23→	ErrNilBlockHeader              = errors.New("nil beacon block header")
    24→	ErrCannotLoadCustodyGroupCount = errors.New("cannot load the custody group count from peer")
    25→)
    26→
    27→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#custody-group-count
    28→type Cgc uint64
    29→
    30→func (Cgc) ENRKey() string { return params.BeaconNetworkConfig().CustodyGroupCountKey }
    31→
    32→// VerifyDataColumnSidecar verifies if the data column sidecar is valid.
    33→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#verify_data_column_sidecar
    34→func VerifyDataColumnSidecar(sidecar blocks.RODataColumn) error {
    35→	// The sidecar index must be within the valid range.
    36→	if sidecar.Index >= fieldparams.NumberOfColumns {
    37→		return ErrIndexTooLarge
    38→	}
    39→
    40→	// A sidecar for zero blobs is invalid.
    41→	if len(sidecar.KzgCommitments) == 0 {
    42→		return ErrNoKzgCommitments
    43→	}
    44→
    45→	// A sidecar with more commitments than the max blob count for this block is invalid.
    46→	slot := sidecar.Slot()
    47→	maxBlobsPerBlock := params.BeaconConfig().MaxBlobsPerBlock(slot)
    48→	if len(sidecar.KzgCommitments) > maxBlobsPerBlock {
    49→		return ErrTooManyCommitments
    50→	}
    51→
    52→	// The column length must be equal to the number of commitments/proofs.
    53→	if len(sidecar.Column) != len(sidecar.KzgCommitments) || len(sidecar.Column) != len(sidecar.KzgProofs) {
    54→		return ErrMismatchLength
    55→	}
    56→
    57→	return nil
    58→}
    59→
    60→// VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs verifies if the KZG proofs are correct.
    61→// Note: We are slightly deviating from the specification here:
    62→// The specification verifies the KZG proofs for each sidecar separately,
    63→// while we are verifying all the KZG proofs from multiple sidecars in a batch.
    64→// This is done to improve performance since the internal KZG library is way more
    65→// efficient when verifying in batch.
    66→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs
    67→func VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs(sidecars []blocks.RODataColumn) error {
    68→	// Compute the total count.
    69→	count := 0
    70→	for _, sidecar := range sidecars {
    71→		count += len(sidecar.Column)
    72→	}
    73→
    74→	commitments := make([]kzg.Bytes48, 0, count)
    75→	indices := make([]uint64, 0, count)
    76→	cells := make([]kzg.Cell, 0, count)
    77→	proofs := make([]kzg.Bytes48, 0, count)
    78→
    79→	for _, sidecar := range sidecars {
    80→		for i := range sidecar.Column {
    81→			var (
    82→				commitment kzg.Bytes48
    83→				cell       kzg.Cell
    84→				proof      kzg.Bytes48
    85→			)
    86→
    87→			commitmentBytes := sidecar.KzgCommitments[i]
    88→			cellBytes := sidecar.Column[i]
    89→			proofBytes := sidecar.KzgProofs[i]
    90→
    91→			if len(commitmentBytes) != len(commitment) ||
    92→				len(cellBytes) != len(cell) ||
    93→				len(proofBytes) != len(proof) {
    94→				return ErrMismatchLength
    95→			}
    96→
    97→			copy(commitment[:], commitmentBytes)
    98→			copy(cell[:], cellBytes)
    99→			copy(proof[:], proofBytes)
   100→
   101→			commitments = append(commitments, commitment)
   102→			indices = append(indices, sidecar.Index)
   103→			cells = append(cells, cell)
   104→			proofs = append(proofs, proof)
   105→		}
   106→	}
   107→
   108→	// Batch verify that the cells match the corresponding commitments and proofs.
   109→	verified, err := kzg.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch(commitments, indices, cells, proofs)
   110→	if err != nil {
   111→		return errors.Wrap(err, "verify cell KZG proof batch")
   112→	}
   113→
   114→	if !verified {
   115→		return ErrInvalidKZGProof
   116→	}
   117→
   118→	return nil
   119→}
   120→
   121→// VerifyDataColumnSidecarInclusionProof verifies if the given KZG commitments included in the given beacon block.
   122→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof
   123→func VerifyDataColumnSidecarInclusionProof(sidecar blocks.RODataColumn) error {
   124→	if sidecar.SignedBlockHeader == nil || sidecar.SignedBlockHeader.Header == nil {
   125→		return ErrNilBlockHeader
   126→	}
   127→
   128→	root := sidecar.SignedBlockHeader.Header.BodyRoot
   129→	if len(root) != fieldparams.RootLength {
   130→		return ErrBadRootLength
   131→	}
   132→
   133→	leaves := blocks.LeavesFromCommitments(sidecar.KzgCommitments)
   134→
   135→	sparse, err := trie.GenerateTrieFromItems(leaves, fieldparams.LogMaxBlobCommitments)
   136→	if err != nil {
   137→		return errors.Wrap(err, "generate trie from items")
   138→	}
   139→
   140→	hashTreeRoot, err := sparse.HashTreeRoot()
   141→	if err != nil {
   142→		return errors.Wrap(err, "hash tree root")
   143→	}
   144→
   145→	verified := trie.VerifyMerkleProof(root, hashTreeRoot[:], kzgPosition, sidecar.KzgCommitmentsInclusionProof)
   146→	if !verified {
   147→		return ErrInvalidInclusionProof
   148→	}
   149→
   150→	return nil
